caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench set against a plain, off-white background. The bench is light brown in color and features a high backrest with five distinct rounded arches along its top edge. The bench has simple, square legs and armrests that curve outward at the ends. The front panel below the seat displays a scalloped design, repeating the arch motif from the backrest. There are visible wood grain details throughout the bench, and the structure is illustrated with perspective, showing its three-dimensional form. The drawing is centered on the page, with no other objects or background elements present. In the lower right corner, there is a small signature or label that reads “Edward T. Jewett.”
title: Wooden Bench
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
